IN THE SPECIAL COURT FOR PMLA & ECONOMIC OFFENSES, NEW DELHI.
Special Criminal Case No. 812/2026: Directorate of Enforcement vs. Vikram Malhotra & Ors.

1. Person Vikram Malhotra [ID:P101] is named as Prime Accused in this case.
2. Person Vikram Malhotra [ID:P101] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-MALHOTRA-771].
3. Charges framed under Section 3 & Section 4 of Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA) read with Section 420 IPC (Cheating) and Section 120B IPC (Criminal Conspiracy).
4. Prosecution establishes that Accused Vikram Malhotra [ID:P101] orchestrated an illegal healthcare procurement cartel diverting $750,000 through front entities.
5. The investigation identified that Accused P101 operated account 010 / ACC-MALHOTRA-771 as the master disbursement pool.
6. The intelligence dossier also records the handwritten alias Singhania in connection with unaccounted offshore bullion purchases.

HIGH COURT OF DELHI // BAIL APPLICATION NO. 441/2026.
In the matter of Sanjay Agarwal vs. State (Directorate of Enforcement).

1. Person Sanjay Agarwal [ID:P102] is named as Accused in this case.
2. Person Sanjay Agarwal [ID:P102] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-AGARWAL-882].
3. Bail is DISMISSED under Section 45 PMLA twin conditions due to high flight risk and ongoing hawala layering activities.
4. Forensic bank records demonstrate that Accused Sanjay Agarwal [ID:P102] received rapid incoming wires from Vikram Malhotra [ID:P101] and immediately split transfers to obscure the audit trail.
5. Interrogation logs confirm Accused P102 served as the designated hawala conduit and cash smurfing mule coordinator for the syndicate.

IN THE SPECIAL COURT FOR PMLA & ECONOMIC OFFENSES, NEW DELHI.
Supplementary Prosecution Complaint against Shell Corporate Conduits.

1. Person Karan Singhania [ID:P103] is referenced in this case as dummy director of Apex Logistics Corp.
2. Person Karan Singhania [ID:P103] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-APEXSHELL-993].
3. Charges under Section 420 IPC and Section 467 IPC (Forgery of valuable security) for floating paper companies with bogus GST billings.
4. Person Rohit Verma [ID:P104] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-VERMA-104] and is referenced in this case as high-velocity structuring operator coordinating peer-to-peer cryptocurrency cash-outs.

WITNESS DEPOSITION & ELECTRONIC DISK SEIZURE MEMO UNDER SECTION 164 CrPC.

1. Person Meera Kapoor [ID:P105] is referenced in this case as a witness.
2. Witness Meera Kapoor [ID:P105] served as Head of Internal Procurement Audit at the vendor consortium.
3. Witness P105 confirmed under oath that tenders were manipulated under direction of Vikram Malhotra [ID:P101].
4. Witness P105 submitted encrypted forensic server logs revealing nocturnal wire transfers executed between 01:00 AM and 04:00 AM across the designated syndicate accounts.
